threads.body: Anthropic 1.14+ enables native SDK tracing when a global tracer provider is registered, which these environments' `opentelemetry-instrument` commands do. The upgrade therefore mixes SDK-native spans with the declared instrumentation's spans instead of measuring one implementation. This affects `anthropic/opentelemetry-anthropic`, `anthropic/openllmetry`, and `anthropic/openinference`. Add `ANTHROPIC_OPEN_TELEMETRY: "false"` under `env` in each directory's `conformance.yaml`, then rerun the scenarios and commit any regenerated `data.json` changes.

The bot commit "Update generated data files" (f966b2fb) regenerated the litellm data.json files from this crashed run. That's why the diff adds error.type and missing gen_ai.response.* and gen_ai.usage.* attributes, and removes the tool-call attributes. Those baselines describe a crash, not real instrumentation behaviour, so they shouldn't be merged. The required-status-check failure only reflects this job failing.

litellm 1.106.0 imports the mcp package on the normal SDK path. mcp isn't installed: the lockfile on the PR branch has no mcp package, and litellm's lock entry doesn't depend on it. So the scenario process exits with code 1.

replies.body: dropped it from version update, it's being fixed in next version
